profile.description: 2026 history-aware prospect. Crestone Energy Fair runs Sept. 11-13, 2026 and is a free, family-friendly community event with a dedicated Family Village. Adventure Zone previously emailed the Energy Fair in Jan. 2024 at vendenergyfair@gmail.com with no reply found. Main fit question is whether one of the downtown park areas can provide enough dedicated footprint and electrical access for a full staffed inflatable carnival.

notes.subject: 2026 review — Crestone Energy Fair
notes.body: Official 2026 information confirms Sept. 11-13 in downtown Crestone across Town Hall Park, Little Pearl Park and Creekside Park. The fair is free and family-friendly and includes a Family Village. Site FAQ says general event power is limited, with power available for vendors/presenters/musicians, so footprint and electrical access must be confirmed before treating this as a strong operational fit. Official vendor contact is vendenergyfair@gmail.com. Adventure Zone Gmail history shows Amy emailed this exact event in Jan. 2024 with no reply found, so current outreach should be a natural check-back rather than a cold introduction. Current long-range regional outlook for Sept. 6-14 is generally sunny with isolated thunderstorms possible in southern areas and cooling temperatures; weather is not currently a reason to rule out pay-for-play. Sources reviewed Aug. 27, 2026: official Crestone Energy Fair site/FAQ/vendor page, Old Farmer's Almanac, Adventure Zone Gmail.

followUps.label: Crestone 2026 space/power follow-up
followUps.reason: After the history-aware 2026 email is sent, follow up only if the organizers indicate they can accommodate a full staffed inflatable carnival. Main questions are dedicated footprint and sufficient electrical access. Keep both prepaid and pay-for-play available; do not push sponsorship wording.
